dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you two. Did Miss Navia invite you to come pay your respects to her father?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mhm! We ran into Navia on the streets today, so we just followed her here.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I see, I see. Then, is there something that I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah... Um... Well, it's pretty hard to run into you like this, since you're usually super busy, so we figured we could try to ask you a few questions, if that's okay...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Please feel free. Though outsiders, you helped us solve one of the greatest mysteries in Fontaine, and it would be my pleasure to return the favor.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That should be all the animals in this area. Time to look for Ryuuji!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, so they're the ones who stole the animals!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #These rascals! C'mon, {NICKNAME}, time to show them what's what!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Ryuuji's not in. Let's go ask Sango, then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sango said that this should be the place. Let's look around and see if we can find Ryuuji.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There! There he is! C'mon, let's go meet him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ugh, these guys are back! Guess it's come down to a fight after all, huh? Be careful not to hurt the animals, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: It's fine. Fight as you wish. I'll take the animals someplace safe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #It's attacking us! {NICKNAME}, you've gotta calm it down somehow!
